INSTRUMENT (Step 3b): 'RSE' here is the study's 'Recent Stressful Experiences' block (Questionnaires.docx Q57), a single select-all-that-apply checklist of 10 past-year events -- NOT the Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale. The instrument_rights_register RSES row's code regex (^rses?[_ ]?[0-9]) matches RSE1..RSE10 case-insensitively; it is a false lead and was not applied. The study's own RSES* columns are a different (resilient-coping) scale in a different table. CODE DERIVATION: data/ehealth_rioux_2025.py melts columns matching ^RSE(\d+|_noanswer)$ by name from ParentPref_OriginalData.csv (CSV export of the same .sav), so the IRW item code IS the source column name; no rename, no positional step. MAPPING/TEXT: each RSEn's SPSS variable label reads '<Q57 stem> <event text>'; the stem 'Which events happened to you in the PAST YEAR (12 months)? (Select as MANY as apply.)' was stripped into instructions (identical on all 11) and the remainder shipped verbatim as item_text, 11/11. Wording also agrees with Questionnaires.docx Q57 options 1-10 and 12. OPTIONS: the .sav's only value label on each column is 1 = <the event text itself> (Qualtrics checkbox), shipped verbatim as option_text for resp=1; resp=0 has no label anywhere in the source (it is the processing script's fill for an unticked box, cf. the study's own syntax 'recode RSE1..RSE10 (sysmis=0)') so option_text is blank for 0, not padded. Route 9 cross-check: .sav counts after the script's fill rule match live item x resp counts cell for cell, 22/22 (e.g. RSE1 154/106, RSE3 132/128, RSE9 220/40, RSE_noanswer 256/4, 0/1 both sides). RIGHTS: the checklist is the study's own block; Questionnaires.docx attributes it to no external instrument (unlike its PSI/GAD/PHQ/MSPSS blocks, which carry citations), so there is no originator page to read and no restriction to quote -- silence is permission. RESPONSE-DATA NOTES (not itemtext defects): (1) Q57 option 11 'None of the above' has no column in the deposit, so the 90 of 350 respondents who ticked no box (none-of-the-above and skippers alike) are absent from the live table (257 unique ids); a respondent with zero events is therefore never observed, and the dictionary Description's 'answered with Yes or No' overstates the format. (2) The 4 RSE_noanswer=1 respondents get resp=0 on RSE1..RSE10 via the fill rule (ids 1511, 3298, 6491 are 0 on all ten), which is not a substantive 'did not happen'; id 2799 ticked both 'Prefer not to answer' and four events. (3) Same duplicate-id defect as the GAD/PHQ/MSSPS siblings: ids 4233, 5063, 9728 carry 22 rows each (two submissions).
